name: Electronics & Electricals
summary: Electrical and electronic product approvals with streamlined lab coordination.
intro: From power banks to smart TVs, every electronic product sold in India needs the right mark before it reaches customs or a marketplace. We map your product to the correct IS standard and run testing, BIS, WPC and BEE in parallel.

name: Toys
summary: Safety-first testing and certification for children's products across global standards.
intro: Toys sold in India need BIS ISI certification under IS 9873 and IS 15644, and export markets ask for EN 71, ASTM F963 or GCC G-Mark. We handle chemical, mechanical and flammability testing in one plan.
highlights: BIS ISI under the Toys QCO

name: Polymers & Plastics
summary: Material validation and compliance for polymers, plastics, and advanced composites.
intro: Plastic raw materials, pipes and packaging face BIS QCOs, EPR obligations and REACH/RoHS restrictions. We combine material testing with registration so your product is compliant from resin to retail.

name: Cosmetics & Personal Care
summary: Regulatory pathways and safety dossiers for cosmetics and personal care launches.
intro: Importing or manufacturing cosmetics in India needs CDSCO registration, a compliant label and safety data. For the Gulf we manage SFDA listings. One dossier, reused across markets.

name: Food & Beverages
summary: Quality, safety, and labeling compliance for food and beverage brands.
intro: FSSAI licensing, import clearance, lab testing and food-safety systems like HACCP and ISO 22000 — we take you from kitchen or factory to shelf and export.

name: Software & Connected Devices
summary: Secure software compliance, cybersecurity, and market readiness for digital products.
intro: Connected products now need cybersecurity evidence: TEC's MTCTE security requirements, STQC audits and the EU Cyber Resilience Act. We plan testing and documentation for hardware and firmware together.
